items.exampleEn: Their engagement party was held at a hotel by the sea.
items.exampleZh: 他們的訂婚派對在海邊的一家飯店舉行。

items.exampleEn: The family's housekeeper has cooked their meals for twenty years.
items.exampleZh: 那家人的管家替他們煮飯已經二十年了。

items.exampleEn: The young designer won an award voted on by her peers.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕設計師得到一個由同行票選的獎項。
items.glossZh: 同儕；同齡或同等地位的人

items.exampleEn: Divorce can be very hard for young children.
items.exampleZh: 離婚對年幼的孩子來說可能很難熬。

items.exampleEn: The airline lets infants under two fly for free.
items.exampleZh: 這家航空公司讓兩歲以下的嬰兒免費搭機。

items.exampleEn: The animal shelter holds an adoption day every Saturday.
items.exampleZh: 動物收容所每週六都會舉辦領養日。

items.exampleEn: In the story, the king's servant finds a magic ring.
items.exampleZh: 故事裡，國王的僕人找到一枚魔法戒指。

items.exampleEn: He went to watch the football match with his mates.
items.exampleZh: 他和朋友們一起去看足球賽。

items.sentenceEn: The couple decided to divorce after ten years of marriage.
items.sentenceZh: 這對夫妻在結婚十年後決定離婚。

items.audioEn: We need a housekeeper who can cook and clean three days a week.
items.audioZh: 我們需要一位每週三天能煮飯、打掃的管家。

items.sentenceEn: Teenagers often care more about what their peers think than about their parents' opinions.
items.sentenceZh: 青少年往往比較在意同儕的想法，勝過父母的意見。

items.sentenceEn: Infants need to sleep for most of the day.
items.sentenceZh: 嬰兒一天大部分的時間都需要睡覺。

items.stemEn: In old movies, rich families often had ____ to open the door and serve dinner.
items.stemZh: 在老電影裡，有錢人家常有僕人負責開門和上菜。

items.stemEn: They announced their ____ at a family dinner and plan to marry next spring.
items.stemZh: 他們在家庭聚餐時宣佈訂婚，打算明年春天結婚。

items.passageEn: My grandparents' engagement lasted three years because they were saving for a house. After they married, my grandmother worked as a housekeeper for a rich family that still had several servants. When my mother was an infant, my grandparents also decided to adopt a little boy from a relative's family: my uncle Tom. Some neighbors were reluctant to accept the idea at first, but my grandparents raised both children with love. My uncle says his mates at school never treated him differently. Today, many of my peers find it hard to believe that my grandparents never even considered divorce in sixty years.
items.passageZh: 我祖父母訂婚了三年，因為他們在存錢買房子。婚後，祖母在一個仍然有好幾個僕人的有錢人家當管家。我媽媽還是嬰兒時，祖父母又決定收養一個親戚家的小男孩，也就是我的舅舅 Tom。有些鄰居起初不太能接受，但祖父母用愛撫養兩個孩子長大。舅舅說，學校的同學從來沒有用不同的眼光看他。如今，我很多同齡的朋友都很難相信，我祖父母結婚六十年來從沒想過要離婚。

questions.questionZh: 祖父母為什麼訂婚了三年？
舅舅說學校同學怎麼對待他？
options: 常常拿他的身世取笑他
從來沒有用不同的眼光看他

items.promptZh: 他們正在考慮收養一個孩子。
referenceEn: They are considering the adoption of a child.
They are thinking about the adoption of a young child.
rubricZh: adoption 是名詞（例如 the adoption of a child）；寫 adopting a child 意思也對
「正在考慮」可寫 are considering、are thinking about 等

items.promptZh: 在新公司，他很快就贏得了同事們的尊重。
referenceEn: At his new company, he quickly won the respect of his peers.
He quickly earned his peers' respect at his new company.
rubricZh: peer 指「同儕、同事」（例如 his peers、the respect of his peers 等）
「贏得尊重」可寫，例如 won the respect of、earned … respect 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 won、has won 等）
